selection: Last uninspected photograph in the fixed round9b frame; not a random sample. Existing individual editorial rows remain unread in this stage.
known_prior: Q000954 related composition and comparison objects have been studied; model prior knowledge cannot be erased. This is image-first sequence, not a fully blind decipherment.
readability_criteria_before_view: Inspect native source pixels, no invented detail. Rotation and cropping are permitted and recorded.

For a limited graph comparison require at least two delineable inscription cells and at least six tentative clusters total, with typical cluster height >=20 native pixels and some distinct wedge strokes. Record uncertain boundaries.
If only part passes, limit claims to that part. No whole-object reading, no inferred negative evidence outside visible surface.
If clusters cannot be reliably separated, freeze unresolved outcome without phonetic or semantic assignment.
prediction: If two cells end with a visibly repeated graphic complex, record their pixel boxes and compare preceding graphic bodies. Repetition can test a segmentation model, but alone cannot determine sound, meaning or genealogical relationship.
freeze_rule: Save observations and image hash before extraction of individual editorial rows. Distinguish actual wedge comparison, tentative clustering and post-exposure reading.
stop_rule: This round assesses one held-out photo; expansion requires a separately recorded follow-up.
